Read the [Development Policy](../../docs/policies/DEVELOPMENT_POLICY.md#test-selection-and-evidence) for layer selection, production-boundary assertions and truthful verification, plus the [Documentation Policy](../../docs/policies/DOCUMENTATION_POLICY.md) for advisory reporting and approval.

The [Testing Guide](../../docs/TESTING_GUIDE.md) contains runner/environment procedures. Executable package and runner configuration remains the command inventory. This file contains no competing layer matrix or database-safety rule.
